summary: The diff strongly implements the requested UI/UX polish via a cohesive visual system (global theme tokens + shared surface/interactive primitives), standardized dialog composition, improved button/control styling, and animated dialog/overlay entrances. However, the diff summary also indicates several unrequested functional and gameplay/scene changes (service worker/offline behavior, share URL sanitization, install-flow logic changes, new online-status hook, and substantial 3D scene/controls changes) that go beyond a UI-only polish request and may violate the stated non-goals.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/modified PWA/service-worker/offline fallback behavior (online-only caching strategy, offline.html) beyond the UI polish request.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on UI/UX visual polish and motion; it explicitly states no new backend logic is required and includes a non-goal of not adding offline gameplay support. The diff summary introduces service worker configuration and an offline fallback page plus related metadata/manifest changes, which were not requested as part of UI polish.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced share URL sanitization utility to remove hash fragments to prevent token exposure.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-41/42/43 (UI/UX polish and motion). This is security/URL behavior logic rather than presentation styling.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/modified PWA install detection and install-flow state machine via a custom hook (idle/prompting/completed/failed) and tightened installed-state detection.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-41 mentions consistent Share/Install flows visually, but does not request changing install detection logic or adding new hook behavior; this goes beyond presentation polish.

hallucinated_features.description: Added an online/offline status hook and an online-required blocking overlay that pauses/blocks gameplay when offline.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of the specified UI polish requirements; also touches gameplay/session behavior (pausing/blocking) rather than only visual styling.

hallucinated_features.description: Substantial 3D scene/gameplay-related changes (steering behavior, road boundaries, obstacles, collision dimensions, player car model, environment props).
hallucinated_features.reason: Explicit non-goal: do not change core gameplay rules/physics/steering/collision/scoring/obstacle behavior as part of this UI polish request. The diff summary claims changes directly in these areas.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (frontend/src/game/scene/TrafficJamScene.tsx: steering movement/clamping, obstacles/collision, car model, environment props)

hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-41/42/43; this is robustness/error handling functionality rather than UI polish.
